WITH config AS (
  SELECT jsonb_object_agg(key,value) AS values
  FROM settings
  WHERE key = ANY (ARRAY[
    'REGION','LANGUAGE','TREND_CALCULATION_VERSION','OPPORTUNITY_CALCULATION_VERSION',
    'RECOMMENDATION_PROMPT_VERSION','REPORT_PERIOD','REPORT_VERSION',
    'REPORT_TOP_OPPORTUNITIES_LIMIT','REPORT_VIRAL_RISK_LIMIT',
    'REPORT_EMERGING_TRENDS_LIMIT','REPORT_VIRALITY_RISK_MIN',
    'REPORT_MONETIZATION_RISK_MAX','REPORT_TIMEZONE'
  ])
), started AS (
  INSERT INTO pipeline_runs (workflow,status,metadata)
  SELECT '09 - TrendLens - Report','running',
         jsonb_build_object(
           'output_formats',jsonb_build_array('json','markdown'),
           'configuration',coalesce(values,'{}'::jsonb),
           'quantitative_source','postgresql'
         )
  FROM config
  RETURNING id,started_at,metadata
)
SELECT id AS pipeline_run_id,started_at AS run_started_at,metadata
FROM started;

WITH generated AS (
  SELECT * FROM build_trendlens_report($2::timestamptz)
), inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO reports (
    period_start,period_end,platform,region,language,generated_at,
    report_version,source_calculation_version,source_opportunity_version,
    recommendation_prompt_version,videos_analyzed,categories_analyzed,
    top_opportunities_count,viral_but_risky_count,emerging_trends_count,
    report_json,report_markdown,source_hash
  )
  SELECT
    period_start,period_end,platform,region,language,generated_at,
    report_version,source_calculation_version,source_opportunity_version,
    recommendation_prompt_version,videos_analyzed,categories_analyzed,
    top_opportunities_count,viral_but_risky_count,emerging_trends_count,
    report_json,report_markdown,source_hash
  FROM generated
  ON CONFLICT (
    period_start,period_end,platform,region,language,report_version,
    source_calculation_version,source_opportunity_version,
    recommendation_prompt_version,source_hash
  ) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING reports.*,true AS report_created
), resolved AS (
  SELECT * FROM inserted
  UNION ALL
  SELECT existing.*,false AS report_created
  FROM reports existing
  CROSS JOIN generated
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted)
    AND existing.period_start=generated.period_start
    AND existing.period_end=generated.period_end
    AND existing.platform=generated.platform
    AND existing.region IS NOT DISTINCT FROM generated.region
    AND existing.language IS NOT DISTINCT FROM generated.language
    AND existing.report_version=generated.report_version
    AND existing.source_calculation_version=generated.source_calculation_version
    AND existing.source_opportunity_version=generated.source_opportunity_version
    AND existing.recommendation_prompt_version=generated.recommendation_prompt_version
    AND existing.source_hash=generated.source_hash
  LIMIT 1
), updated AS (
  UPDATE pipeline_runs
  SET items_received=resolved.categories_analyzed,
      items_processed=CASE WHEN resolved.report_created THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
      items_skipped=CASE WHEN resolved.report_created THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
      api_calls=0,
      metadata=metadata || jsonb_build_object(
        'report_id',resolved.id,
        'report_created',resolved.report_created,
        'source_hash',resolved.source_hash,
        'period_start',resolved.period_start,
        'period_end',resolved.period_end,
        'context',jsonb_build_object(
          'platform',resolved.platform,'region',resolved.region,'language',resolved.language
        ),
        'videos_analyzed',resolved.videos_analyzed,
        'categories_analyzed',resolved.categories_analyzed,
        'top_opportunities',resolved.top_opportunities_count,
        'viral_but_risky',resolved.viral_but_risky_count,
        'emerging_trends',resolved.emerging_trends_count,
        'report_version',resolved.report_version,
        'recommendation_prompt_version',resolved.recommendation_prompt_version
      )
  FROM resolved
  WHERE pipeline_runs.id=$1::bigint
  RETURNING pipeline_runs.*
)
SELECT
  updated.id AS pipeline_run_id,
  resolved.id AS report_id,
  resolved.report_created,
  resolved.period_start,resolved.period_end,
  resolved.platform,resolved.region,resolved.language,
  resolved.videos_analyzed,resolved.categories_analyzed,
  resolved.top_opportunities_count,resolved.viral_but_risky_count,
  resolved.emerging_trends_count,resolved.report_json,
  resolved.report_markdown,resolved.source_hash
FROM updated CROSS JOIN resolved;

WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE pipeline_runs
  SET finished_at=coalesce(finished_at,current_timestamp),
      status='success',
      duration_seconds=coalesce(duration_seconds,extract(epoch FROM (current_timestamp-started_at)))
  WHERE id=$1::bigint
  RETURNING *
)
SELECT
  updated.id AS pipeline_run_id,updated.workflow,updated.status,
  updated.items_received,updated.items_processed,updated.items_skipped,
  updated.items_failed,updated.duration_seconds,updated.metadata,
  updated.started_at,updated.finished_at,
  report.id AS report_id,report.report_json,report.report_markdown
FROM updated
LEFT JOIN reports report ON report.id=(updated.metadata ->> 'report_id')::bigint;

WITH args AS (
  SELECT $1::bigint AS run_id,$2::text AS message
), logged AS (
  INSERT INTO pipeline_errors (
    pipeline_run_id,workflow,node,error_type,error_message,retry_count,metadata
  )
  SELECT args.run_id,'09 - TrendLens - Report','Gerar e persistir relatório','report_generation_error',
         left(regexp_replace(args.message,'(?i)(authorization|api[_-]?key|token|password|secret)[^ ,;]*','[REDACTED]','g'),4000),
         2,jsonb_build_object('output_formats',jsonb_build_array('json','markdown'))
  FROM args
  RETURNING id
), updated AS (
  UPDATE pipeline_runs
  SET finished_at=current_timestamp,status='failed',items_failed=items_failed+1,
      duration_seconds=extract(epoch FROM (current_timestamp-started_at))
  FROM args
  WHERE pipeline_runs.id=args.run_id
  RETURNING pipeline_runs.*
)
SELECT updated.id AS pipeline_run_id,updated.status,updated.items_failed,
       (SELECT id FROM logged) AS pipeline_error_id
FROM updated;
